rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a shallow, flat-bottomed frying pan.

example.english: I fried two eggs in a frying pan.
example.traditional: 我用平底鑊煎咗兩隻蛋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ping4 dai2 wok6 zin1 zo2 loeng5 zek3 daan2

rows.note: A speaker uses this broader word when referring to a cooking pan generically or when the exact shape is unimportant.

example.english: Wash the frying pan after cooking.
example.traditional: 煮完餸就將隻鑊洗乾淨。
example.jyutping: zyu2 jyun4 sung3 zau6 zoeng1 zek3 wok6 sai2 gon1 zeng6
